content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Teaching Personnel Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GBPUAT Teaching Personnel Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GBPUAT Teaching Personnel recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026. There is no separate last date for submitting an application form before the interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by GBPUAT?
faq.answer: GBPUAT has announced a total of 3 vacancies for the post of Teaching Personnel. These vacancies are for the Mathematics, Statistics and Computer Science department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Teaching Personnel post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctorate Degree in the subject concerned or a Master's degree in the relevant discipline with at least 60% marks. NET/SLET is also essential in most cases.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on an hourly basis. Candidates eligible for Assistant Professor can receive Rs. 650/- per hour (max Rs. 30,000/- per month), while Master's degree holders will get Rs. 550/- per hour (max Rs. 25,000/- per month).

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in interview. Interested candidates need to appear directly at the interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the College Seminar Room, College of Basic Sciences & Humanities, G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology, Pantnagar-263145.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies of their certificates (academic, experience, publications, reservation category), and a bio-data.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, a relaxation of 5% is provided for SC/ST/Differently-abled candidates in their educational qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Teaching Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and performance during the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are contract-based positions for the 1st Semester of the Academic Year 2026-27.
